note: Offline mock evaluation — not live discovery. Candidates are advisory only.

candidates.title: local-first quality gate for secondary tier
candidates.description: When CORTEX_LOCAL_FIRST is armed, secondary-tier tasks try local first with a quality gate before spending paid quota. Tested at STRUCTURAL level.

candidates.title: circuit breaker per-provider fail-fast
candidates.description: After 5 failures, breaker OPEN blocks network calls. Half-open recovery needs 2 successes.

candidates.title: action_sha256 binding on outbound approval
candidates.description: Outbound HTTPS jobs bind a content hash that must match at execute time — TOCTOU defense.

candidates.title: collaborator content-free memory
candidates.description: Memory summaries contain only owner_input_sha256 digest, never raw owner text. Deterministic turn_id for replay idempotency.

candidates.title: context_bundle schema enforcement
candidates.description: Bundles with wrong schema are rejected, not silently relabeled.
